title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Matthew 18: who is greatest in the Kingdom, the sheep that went astray, correcting a brother, and the servant who would not forgive.

questions.text: What did the disciples come and ask Jesus in that hour?
questions.explanation: The disciples came to Jesus asking who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

answers.text: When the Kingdom of Heaven would come
Whether they should fast
Who is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven
Who among them would betray him

questions.text: What did Jesus say people must do to enter into the Kingdom of Heaven?
questions.explanation: He set a little child in the middle of them and said that unless they turn and become as little children, they will in no way enter the Kingdom of Heaven.

answers.text: Turn and become as little children
Give away all their bread
Learn the words of the scribes
Go up to the temple each day

questions.text: What did Jesus say about whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in him to stumble?
questions.explanation: He said it would be better for that person if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

answers.text: That he would be sent away from the assembly
That it would be better for him to be sunk in the sea
That he would owe a debt he could never repay
That he would be called least in the Kingdom

questions.text: What did Jesus say to do if your hand or your foot causes you to stumble?
questions.explanation: He said to cut it off and cast it from you, since it is better to enter into life maimed or crippled than to be cast into the eternal fire with two hands or two feet.

answers.text: Bind it until it heals
Wash it with water
Pray over it for seven days
Cut it off and cast it from you

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the angels of these little ones?
questions.explanation: He said not to despise one of these little ones, because in heaven their angels always see the face of his Father who is in heaven.

answers.text: That in heaven their angels always see the face of his Father
That their angels keep watch at the temple gates
That their angels carry their prayers to the altar
That their angels will judge the nations

questions.text: In the parable, how many sheep does the man leave to go and seek the one that has gone astray?
questions.explanation: Jesus asked whether a man with one hundred sheep would not leave the ninety-nine and go to the mountains to seek the one that had gone astray.

answers.text: Forty-nine
Seventy-seven
Ninety-nine
Thirty-nine

questions.text: What did Jesus say to do first if your brother sins against you?
questions.explanation: He said to go and show him his fault between you and him alone, and if he listens you have gained back your brother.

answers.text: Tell it to the whole assembly at once
Wait quietly until he comes to you
Take two or three witnesses with you first
Show him his fault between you and him alone

questions.text: According to Jesus, what should happen if the brother will not listen to the one or two who came along?
questions.explanation: He said that if the brother refuses to listen to them, you should tell it to the assembly.

answers.text: Let the matter rest
Tell it to the assembly
Bring him to the elders of the city
Forgive him and say nothing

questions.text: How often did Jesus say to forgive, when Peter asked whether it should be until seven times?
questions.explanation: Peter asked whether he should forgive until seven times, and Jesus answered, not until seven times, but until seventy times seven.

answers.text: Until seventy times seven
Until seven times only
Until three times a day
Until the brother asks no more

questions.text: In the parable, how much did the fellow servant owe the man who had been forgiven ten thousand talents?
questions.explanation: The servant who had been forgiven found a fellow servant who owed him one hundred denarii, and grabbed him by the throat demanding payment.

answers.text: Ten talents
One hundred denarii
Two thousand talents
Thirty pieces of silver
